paper_title: 3D template-based Fermi-LAT constraints on the diffuse supernova axion-like particle background
notes: Observed 95% CL upper limit (solid crimson line) from Fig. 10, benchmark DSNALPB scenario (f_fail-CC=20%, Salpeter IMF, fiducial SNR). Curve extracted from the vector PDF ancillary figure file ALP_joint_upper_limits_redshifted_DSNALPB_flux_w_HeavyNuclei_Mfail_20percent_statistical_uncertainty.pdf, crimson stroke RGB(0.863,0.078,0.235); light-red dashed (Calore et al. spectrum-only comparison) excluded. Axes calibrated from tick-label positions (191.2 px/decade in m, 148.45 px/decade in g); flat portion anchored to the paper's headline value g_agamma <= 3.76e-11 GeV^-1 for m_a << 1e-11 eV. Limit is flat at 3.76e-11 GeV^-1 up to ~1e-10 eV then rises; curve traced to top of plot frame (~1.4e-9 GeV^-1 near 1.4e-8 eV). Not a dark-matter search (diffuse SN ALP gamma-ray background), so no DM density dependence. Systematic band spans g_agamma in [2.38,7.04]e-11 GeV^-1 (Table V) but headline/benchmark curve reported here.
